Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Founder's Office Level 1 desk game sprite
Subject: A basic rectangular startup-office table used as a desk: pale simple plywood top, four plain slender steel legs, no drawers, modest and practical.
Composition: Orientation: founder works from the NORTH side facing south, visitor is south facing north. Camera is to the SOUTH. Paint ONLY the SOUTH VISITOR-SIDE FACE of the desk; no operator-side drawers or operator-side knee-hole. Painted pixel-art illustration matching a cosy detailed hospital-management game: hand-painted texture, crisp dark outlines, upper-left soft lighting, muted material colours and faint contact shadow only. A single isolated complete empty furniture/decor sprite on a genuinely transparent background, centred with generous clear padding. No people, room, floor backdrop, labels, logos, readable text, letters, numbers, watermarks, wounds or blood.
This is appearance tier 1 of five. Keep the requested degree of extravagance; do not add luxury beyond this tier.
